title: Unit Age Share Table for Labor-Only Harbison Protection Contracts Claims
content:
**Rule.** On a claim against a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, a unit age share is applied by multiplication to the labor allowed on the claim. The unit age share is set by the whole calendar months from the installed date of the Harbison installation named on the contract — the installation record under Replacement System Installations — or from the contract's coverage start where the contract names no installation, to the failure date (the completed date of the claim's service call).

| Whole calendar months from the installed date (or coverage start) to the failure date | Unit age share |
|---|---|
| more than 96 months | 0.80 |
| more than 60 and up to 96 months | 0.90 |
| 60 months or fewer | 1 |

**Both sides of each threshold.**

| Months | Share |
|---|---|
| 60 | 1 |
| 61 | 0.90 |
| 96 | 0.90 |
| 97 | 0.80 |

**Counting whole months (hypothetical dates).** Installed date 14 May 2018:

- failure date 13 May 2026: 95 whole months, because the 96th month completes only on 14 May 2026 — share 0.90;
- failure date 14 May 2026: 96 whole months — share 0.90;
- failure date 14 June 2026: 97 whole months — share 0.80.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A labor allowed of $1100.00 on a unit with 100 whole months in service takes a share of 0.80: $1100.00 multiplied by 0.80 is $880.00.
